name: relationships
description: Daily relationship cockpit. /relationships produces a prioritized 3-bucket brief (new business, relationship building, network expansion) with 3 actions per bucket — each one ships with a recommended channel, time estimate, and a copy-ready draft drawn from a template library. v0.2.0 adds the intent dimension (client_delivery / drive_active / door_opening / reciprocal / advising / content_share / keep_warm / passive_visibility / awaiting_reply) so the brief frames cards according to the dynamic of engagement, not just cadence. /setup-relationships captures your ICP, tier definitions, voices, and time-budget preferences. Builds on cortex person pages + voice + identity; delegates research to contact-researcher and pipeline-analyst when installed. Drafts only — never sends.
